card.name: Feeding-tube and bottle preparation steps
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or digits inside step-by-step instructions for giving liquid medicine through a feeding tube or bottle. Typical spots are before a water volume in mL, or after bottle, cap, syringe and tube.

modes.label: Before flush volumes
modes.description: A space or digit just before the mL amount of water used to flush a feeding tube.
modes.example: Using a catheter-tip syringe, flush the feeding tube with<< >>30 mL of water.

modes.label: Bottle and cap steps
modes.description: A linking word or colon right after bottle or cap in preparation instructions.
modes.example: Close bottle<< with>> child-resistant cap tightly.

modes.label: Tube and container wording
modes.description: A small word or word part in sentences about tubes or container condition.
modes.example: Use an ent<<eral>> tube that is 8 FR or higher

card.plain: It marks the spots in how-to steps for syringes, tubes and bottles where a volume or a handling detail comes next.
